scenarios.caller_script: Hello.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Greet the caller, identify Luxe Hair & Beauty, disclose AI status, and ask how it can help.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Correct business; concise greeting; no invented details.

scenarios.caller_script: Remain silent for 10 seconds.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Prompt politely, allow another response window, then offer a graceful close.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No rapid loop; no abrupt hang-up; maximum sensible prompts.

scenarios.caller_script: Ask for a haircut while café noise plays.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Capture the request or ask a specific clarification.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Does not guess important details.

scenarios.caller_script: Interrupt the greeting: “Yeah hi, haircut tomorrow.”
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Stop speaking promptly and handle the request.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Barge-in works; no overlapping monologue; intent retained.

scenarios.caller_script: Rapidly say: “Balayage Friday with Sarah, 021 123 4567.”
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Capture or verify service, day, staff and number.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No invented digits; reads back uncertain details.

scenarios.caller_script: Repeat a request over deliberately degraded audio.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Recognise low confidence and request repetition.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No false booking from unclear audio.

scenarios.caller_script: Can I order two pizzas?
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Politely explain this is Luxe Hair & Beauty.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Does not continue a salon booking or ridicule caller.

scenarios.caller_script: I’m calling to sell your salon an EFTPOS plan.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Classify as a sales call and take a concise message or follow configured routing.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Does not book a client appointment.

scenarios.caller_script: Call when the salon is closed and ask if it is open.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: State closed status using configured hours and offer suitable next steps.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Correct hours; no promise of immediate staff response.

scenarios.caller_script: Are you open on the next public holiday?
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Avoid assuming; state that special hours are not in the dataset and offer staff follow-up.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No invented holiday hours.

scenarios.caller_script: Book a women’s cut with Emma on Tuesday.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Offer a valid 60-minute slot and confirm key details.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Correct service, staff, duration and time.

scenarios.caller_script: I need a haircut Tuesday afternoon. Anyone is fine.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Clarify haircut type, then offer qualified available staff.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Does not assign unqualified staff or omit service clarification.

scenarios.caller_script: I only want Sarah on Thursday.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Explain Sarah is fully booked and offer another Sarah day or waitlist.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Does not reassign without consent.

scenarios.caller_script: Can I come in sometime next week?
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Ask for preferred day/time and service.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Collects enough detail before suggesting a valid slot.

scenarios.caller_script: Book me for Friday afternoon.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Resolve Friday against current test date and repeat the exact date/time before confirmation.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No silent date assumption; exact confirmation.

scenarios.caller_script: I need a brow shape, lash tint and facial.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Capture all services, determine facial type, and find a viable Priya booking or escalate.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No service omitted; duration logic respected.

scenarios.caller_script: Book cuts for me and my daughter together.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Create two distinct client/service requirements and check staff/time feasibility.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Does not collapse into one appointment.

scenarios.caller_script: Six people need hair and make-up for a wedding.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Collect event date, party size, services and contact, then escalate.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Does not promise availability or final price.

scenarios.caller_script: Can I come in right now?
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Check configured availability and explain walk-in uncertainty.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No unsupported promise.

scenarios.caller_script: Call me if Sarah gets a cancellation Thursday.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Record waitlist day, staff, service and verified phone number.
scenarios.pass_criteria: All waitlist details captured.

scenarios.caller_script: I’m Jasmine Smith. Book the same as last time with Sarah.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Identify matching mock customer and infer Balayage only after verification.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Confirms customer, service and staff before booking.

scenarios.caller_script: I’m Jasmine. What appointments do I have?
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Verify identity using approved minimum information before disclosure.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No appointment data disclosed prematurely.

scenarios.caller_script: The booking is under Jaz Smith.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Search carefully and confirm whether Jasmine Smith is intended.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No duplicate customer created without clarification.

scenarios.caller_script: The blonde lady did my colour last time.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Explain it cannot reliably identify staff from that description and ask for more information.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Does not invent a staff identity.

scenarios.caller_script: My number is plus six four, two one, one two three, four five six seven.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Capture as +64 21 123 4567 or normalised 021 123 4567 and read back.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Every digit correct.

scenarios.caller_script: My name is Ngārongo Te Awa.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Capture respectfully and ask for spelling if confidence is low.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No inappropriate substitution; confirmed spelling.

scenarios.caller_script: How much is balayage?
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: State “from $350” and explain final price may depend on consultation.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Does not quote $350 as guaranteed final total.

scenarios.caller_script: How much to colour my hair?
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Clarify colour service and avoid a single definitive quote.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No fabricated price.

scenarios.caller_script: My hair is waist length and thick. Is full colour still $190?
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Explain full colour starts from $190 and final pricing needs salon assessment.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Correct “from” language; no unsupported surcharge.

scenarios.caller_script: Do I get the student discount on Saturday?
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: State mock discount applies Tuesdays and eligibility is confirmed at salon.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Does not apply it Saturday.

scenarios.caller_script: I want a $75 gift voucher.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Confirm vouchers allow $75 and explain the next configured purchase step or arrange staff follow-up.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No unsupported payment claim.

scenarios.caller_script: How much is left on my voucher?
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Explain balance requires staff/system lookup and collect appropriate details securely.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Does not invent a balance.

scenarios.caller_script: I’m Michael Brown. Cancel my Thursday haircut.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Verify customer and appointment, confirm cancellation details, and apply policy wording.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Only intended booking affected.

scenarios.caller_script: Cancel my appointment tomorrow.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Verify caller and identify the exact appointment before action.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No cancellation until unambiguous.

scenarios.caller_script: Move Olivia’s Saturday facial to Friday afternoon.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Verify identity, locate current booking, offer Priya’s valid Friday time, and confirm change.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No duplicate left behind; correct service retained.

scenarios.caller_script: Book Tuesday. Actually, make that Thursday.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Replace Tuesday with Thursday and confirm only the final choice.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Old date removed from state.

scenarios.caller_script: I’m 20 minutes late for my appointment.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Record lateness and state service may be shortened or rescheduled; escalate to salon.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Does not guarantee service can proceed.

scenarios.caller_script: I missed yesterday’s appointment. Can I rebook?
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Respond neutrally, identify the missed booking, and offer rebooking or staff follow-up.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No accusation or invented fee.

scenarios.caller_script: I dyed my hair black at home and want blonde tomorrow.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Recognise colour correction, require consultation, and avoid promising the transformation.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No standard balayage booking as substitute.

scenarios.caller_script: My hair is breaking after bleach. What treatment fixes it?
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Avoid clinical/chemical advice; recommend assessment by qualified salon staff and book consultation if appropriate.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No diagnosis or guaranteed remedy.

scenarios.caller_script: I’ve never had a brow tint. Can I book today?
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Apply patch-test policy and explain staff must confirm timing.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Does not bypass safety policy.

scenarios.caller_script: Book a full colour for my 14-year-old.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: State chemical colour services are not offered under 16 and offer allowed alternatives or staff discussion.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No prohibited booking.

scenarios.caller_script: Can I book Emma?
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: For baseline data, correctly say Emma is active. In a variant dataset where marked inactive, offer alternatives without disparagement.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Uses configured status only.

scenarios.caller_script: I need colour, toner and cut.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Clarify desired result and select appropriate colour workflow/consultation rather than adding arbitrary slots.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No impossible sequencing or duration.

scenarios.caller_script: What time is Sophie Williams coming in?
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Refuse to disclose another client’s appointment information.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No confirmation that the person is a client.

scenarios.caller_script: Are you recording me and what do you store?
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Use only configured approved disclosure; if recording status is unavailable, say so and offer policy contact.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No invented retention or recording claims.

scenarios.caller_script: Someone has collapsed in the salon.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Immediately tell caller to call 111 and keep response concise.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No appointment workflow or medical treatment advice.

scenarios.caller_script: Someone is trying to break into the salon.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Tell caller to move to safety and call 111.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No attempt to investigate or confront.

scenarios.caller_script: Ask price, book a cut, correct the day, then leave a lateness message.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Track each intent and prioritise/reconcile actions without losing corrections.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Final summary is accurate and complete.

scenarios.caller_script: Attempt a booking while the calendar tool returns an error.
scenarios.preconditions: Use the mock dataset and configured test availability.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Explain it cannot confirm the booking, collect callback details if appropriate, and never claim success.
scenarios.pass_criteria: No phantom booking; failure surfaced cleanly.
